history.title: History
history.description: Earlier versions of these settings, newest first. Restoring one saves the current state first, so it can be undone the same way.
history.empty: No earlier versions yet. One is kept every time these settings change.
history.unavailable: Could not load the history. Reload the page and try again.
history.changeCount: {count, plural, one {# difference} other {# differences}} from now
history.confirm: Put these settings back the way they were at {date}?
history.restoreFailed: Could not restore that version. It may have been removed - reload and try again.

bin.title: Recycle bin
bin.description: Deleted services, databases and projects wait here until the date shown, then are removed for good.
bin.unavailable: Could not load the recycle bin. Reload the page and try again.
bin.confirmDelete: Delete {name} for good? Its data cannot be brought back.
bin.binRestoreFailed: Could not restore it. Its project may be in the bin too - restore that first.
bin.binDeleteFailed: Could not delete it. Try again in a moment.
bin.daysInvalid: Use a number of days between 1 and 365.
bin.off: The recycle bin is off here: deleting removes things for good straight away.

importSite.title: Import a site
importSite.description: Upload a cPanel full-account backup (.tar.gz). Its sites, MySQL databases and domains become a new project.
importSite.wrongType: Choose the backup as a .tar.gz file.
importSite.tooLarge: The backup is larger than 5 GB.
importSite.importing: Importing. You can close this window; the import keeps going and shows here when it ends.
importSite.done: Imported {services, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}}, {databases, plural, one {# database} other {# databases}} and {domains, plural, one {# domain} other {# domains}}.
importSite.unreachable: Could not reach Polaris. Check your connection and try again.
importSite.notAllowed: You cannot create projects in this organization.
importSite.failed: The import did not finish, and what it had made was removed. Try again in a moment.
importSite.busy: Another import is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

warning.noDomains: No domains were found in the backup; add them to the project after the import.
warning.noHome: The backup has no home folder, so no site files were imported.
warning.databaseFailed: The database {name} could not be imported.
warning.folderMissing: The folder of {name} is not in the backup, so it was not imported.
warning.domainTaken: {name} could not be attached; it may already be in use.
warning.notDeploying: {name} was imported but did not start deploying; deploy it from its page.
warning.unknown: Something in the backup could not be carried over.
warning.databaseUnlinked: {name} was not pointed at a database; set its connection in its variables.

refusal.notCpanel: That is not a cPanel account backup.
refusal.homeUnreadable: The backup's home folder could not be read.
refusal.tooManyFiles: The backup has more than {max, number} files.
refusal.tooLarge: The backup unpacks to more than {gb, number} GB.
refusal.specialFiles: The backup contains links or special files, which are not imported.
refusal.unreadableListing: The backup's file list could not be read.
refusal.absolutePath: The backup contains an absolute path.
refusal.leavesFolder: The backup contains a path that leaves its folder.
refusal.controlCharacters: The backup contains a file name with control characters.

binSettings.title: Recycle bin
binSettings.intro: Deleted services, databases and projects wait in the bin before they are removed for good.
binSettings.enabled: Keep deleted items in the recycle bin
binSettings.offHint: Off: deleting removes it for good straight away. Items already in the bin keep their date.
binSettings.failed: Could not save it. Try again in a moment.
binSettings.lockNoDeploy: Changing this needs permission to manage Deploy.
binSettings.lockNotOrgAdmin: Only the owners and admins of {org} can change this.

isolation.title: Give each environment its own network
isolation.intro: These environments still share one network with every other project, so any service can reach theirs by name. Closing them restarts what runs in them. Domains and published ports keep working.
isolation.needsUpdate: This server cannot make private networks yet. Update Polaris from Settings, then come back here.
isolation.changeIsolate: Gets its own network. Everything running in it restarts, databases first.
isolation.changeRestart: Already private, but its routed services still sit on the shared network until they restart.
isolation.nothingRuns: Nothing is running, so nothing restarts.
isolation.truncated: More environments are waiting. They are listed here once these are done.
isolation.kept: Kept as they are. You can still change each environment under its project's Networking settings.
isolation.started: Restarting {count, plural, one {# service} other {# services}}. Each one shows in its history.
isolation.failed: Could not do that. Try again in a moment.
isolation.confirmBody: {environments, plural, one {# environment gets} other {# environments get}} a network of its own and {count, plural, one {# service restarts} other {# services restart}}. Anything in another project that reaches them by name stops reaching them.
isolation.homeNotice: {count, plural, one {# environment shares} other {# environments share}} one network with every other project.
isolation.isolatedOnly: Done. Nothing was running, so nothing restarts.
